# About Dhairya

Hi! I'm Dhairya, a Computer Science graduate from IIIT Delhi.

I enjoy building practical AI systems that solve real-world problems. My primary interests are in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and backend engineering.

I particularly enjoy working on projects that combine research with production-ready software. My recent work includes industrial video understanding using Vision-Language Models, recommender systems, NLP applications, and deep learning for computer vision.

I believe AI should solve practical problems rather than exist only as research prototypes. Because of this, I enjoy building complete systems—from data preprocessing and model development to deployment using Docker, FastAPI, Hugging Face Spaces, and cloud services.
